topic: Accepting a twenty six percent card rate vs calling to negotiate it down (Sully vs Bernadette)

scenes.narration: One five minute call can cut your card interest rate. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding a phone and a credit card, comic burst banner reads FIVE MINUTE CALL, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Sully and Bernadette each carry four thousand on a card.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man sully and woman bernadette holding statements reading FOUR THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both pay twenty six percent annual interest.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two statements with rates circled reading TWENTY SIX PERCENT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Sully assumes the rate is fixed and untouchable.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man sully shrugging at a statement, thought bubble reading NOTHING I CAN DO, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His interest costs eighty six dollars every month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man sully straining under a barbell stamped EIGHTY SIX A MONTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Bernadette calls and asks for a lower rate.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman bernadette on the phone with a card issuer, calm and prepared, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She cites two years on time and a competing offer.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman bernadette holding a payment history sheet and a competitor offer letter, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The issuer drops her rate to seventeen percent.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a phone screen confirming a new rate reading SEVENTEEN PERCENT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her interest falls to fifty six dollars monthly.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a lighter barbell stamped FIFTY SIX A MONTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She keeps the same payment, so the balance shrinks faster.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a balance bar shrinking quickly with a steady payment arrow, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: That one call saved her nine hundred dollars in interest.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman bernadette flexing beside a gym scoreboard reading NINE HUNDRED SAVED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Call and ask today, the worst answer is no. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing his whistle in a gym holding a clipboard reading CALL AND ASK, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
